question: What did 10a70f579b483a3cfaca9265b850d7fcf6fad591 change for NTFS index growth, the file key, and a quiet log?
allowedInputs: Reported: this commit has no Cursor trailer. No guest log cited by it was still on disk when this note was written.

The on-disk claims in the old wording are withdrawn. Standard information stays the struct in sdk/lib/fslib/ntfslib/ntfslib.h. Log replay, the quota value, and the encrypted file body are unimplemented until a later note cites a Learn page, an in-tree header, or a guest log.
